title: Creamy Greek Pilaf Bowl
description: A simple and flavorful pilaf bowl with creamy feta, fresh herbs, and a fried egg. Perfect for a quick and satisfying lunch.
instructions: Cook the Greek pilaf according to package instructions.
In a small bowl, whisk together the Greek yogurt and a pinch of salt.
Stir in the crumbled feta cheese until well combined.
Add the chopped parsley and dill to the yogurt mixture and stir to combine.
To assemble the bowls, divide the cooked pilaf among four bowls.
Top each bowl with a spoonful of the yogurt-feta mixture.
Fry an egg in a non-stick skillet over medium heat until the whites are set and the yolks are cooked to desired doneness.
Place a fried egg on top of each bowl.
